description: This file contains test cases for the DeviceModelCatalog component, validating its behavior in mapping device identifiers to symbol strings and presentation titles.

classes.name: DeviceModelCatalogTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests validating DeviceModelCatalog's device identifier to symbol mapping and presentation logic.

methods.name: `symbol prefers model identifier prefixes`
methods.description: Tests that DeviceModelCatalog.symbol returns correct prefixes based on device family and model identifier.

methods.name: `symbol uses friendly name for mac variants`
methods.description: Tests that DeviceModelCatalog.symbol returns appropriate symbols when given friendly names for Mac devices.

methods.name: `symbol falls back to device family`
methods.description: Tests that DeviceModelCatalog.symbol defaults to device family name when other info is insufficient.

methods.name: `presentation uses bundled model mappings`
methods.description: Tests that DeviceModelCatalog.presentation correctly returns a presentation object with the expected title.
